notes.title: Introducing quests and badges
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Spring Festival! 🐍[/h2]
[h3]With this new Year of the Snake we are introducing two exciting feature additions:[/h3]

[b]New Event Space with Quests[/b]
In celebration of seasonal events you now have the chance to earn exclusive rewards by completing tasks in the game. Quests are purely optional and can be found in the new event space via main menu. Check there for available rewards and your progress on individual quests.

[b]Badges[/b]
Earned some badges through quests? Then showcase them for the world to see! With this update you can choose any of your unlocked badges and add them to your player card in lobby. And if you don’t want to show any, just select “none”. As time goes by more exclusive badges will be added, but make sure to earn seasonal badges when they come as they might not be unlockable after the event ends. 


The entire Acureus team wishes you good fortune and prosperity! Happy new year!

notes.title: Ready, set, stream!
notes.content:
With today’s update, Draw & Guess adds new [b]interactivity features[/b] targeted at [b]Twitch streamers[/b]. So far your chat audience could watch you play – now they can [b]play along[/b]!

On our brand-new streaming tab (added to lobby settings) choose to let them…

- vote on game modifiers
- suggest prompts
- guess along
- and/or decide whether in-game players guesses are right!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/10ea10f85857b0c97f4e246f35b11b59face67e1.jpg[/img]

Interactive streaming settings are available for Whisper and Stage modes. ***[b][i]With streaming activated[/i][/b], [i]Stage does not require a minimum of 2 in-game players[/i] anymore, while the 4-player minimum requirement for Whisper still stands.

Combine streaming with our content moderation features, and you’re ready for an epic night (or day) of streaming!

[h3]For all you non-streamers, here’s what else we put into this update:[/h3]
- Added support for pixel art in sketchbook
- When game settings are changed, a system message is now displayed in chat, and players are set to “unready” for significant changes
- Added a “save” button to sketchbook so images can be saved without closing the draw module
- 0-9 can now be used as shortcuts to access palette colors
- Significantly improved game load times when users had many stored matches in their matchbook
- Optimised layout for Whisper-games in match-history
- UI fixes
- Added seasonal designs and special new characters!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/9294d4823430f34fd41bcab2a616eb33218db669.png[/img]

notes.title: Adding Trust Score and Content Moderation tools
notes.content:
We have now launched a new system for players to evaluate their in-game experience with other players, and to address concerns relating to disruptive behaviour having a bad influence on the game experience. This update also includes a number of Content Moderation tools giving streamers more power to control game content shown on their stream.

[h2]Trust Score[/h2]
This new score has been attributed to each player and can range from 1 (lowest) to a maximum of 5 (exceptional), with a default value of 3 (good). It will be calculated based on several factors including [b]reports[/b] and [b]praises[/b] by other players.  

[h3]Praising players[/h3]
If you want to highlight that a player was especially great to play with, for example, you can praise them in the ending screen of a completed game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/a863271b8a22cae4a1ec1c5b3dba89a1fa183be2.png[/img]

[h3]Reporting players[/h3]
In the unfortunate case that a player behaves in a harmful or intentionally disruptive way, you can report them via the report button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/a3f23f14d052c5f047558b9ec7905d3f8ee4b97e.png[/img]

[h3]Public lobbies[/h3]
To ensure players find a safe space in [b]public[/b] lobbies, hosts can manually adjust the [b]minimum[/b] required trust score for entering their lobbies. Said score can not be higher than the host’s score, and the [i]score does not apply for private lobbies[/i]. When hosts select a minimum score of “1”, any player can enter their lobbies, regardless of score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/643a9ba4c61f3ab9b4645ac4325fdce871364567.png[/img]

[h2]Why are we doing this?[/h2]
We want to ensure that players in Draw & Guess feel safe and welcome, and that everyone can focus on what the game is about: Drawing, Guessing, and having a good time. We believe the trust score is a good tool to help in that regard as it empowers players to decide themselves how they want to set up their public lobbies, and gives them a meaningful way to send feedback on others.

[h2]Content Moderation Tools[/h2]
With this update we have added tools to [b]moderate incoming chat, prompts, guesses and images[/b]. They all have their home on the new “Safety” tab in the general game settings, together with a handy guide explaining how they work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/332df381d8fda51e802663dc4e6f2c46f1757d75.png[/img]

In the new freely-positioned preview panel streamers can check each item submitted by other players before making them fully visible to their audience. That way streamers can more freely play in public lobbies without risking that other players disturb their stream with unfitting content.

[h2]… did you know?[/h2]
In addition to the trust score, players and hosts can use a range of other ways to moderate their lobbies and improve their game experience. Players can mute other players in lobby, in game modes – and in lobby drawing. Muting does not affect a player’s ability to guess in the game, only their messages are not being forwarded. Hosts can kick players both in lobby and in game modes and can delete a rogue player’s drawings in lobby drawing.

We’ve added answers to many frequently asked questions to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1483870/discussions/0/4409669206918052787/]FAQ section[/url] in the discussion board.

Can you make it to the top of our monthly leaderboard? Check your standing and earn enough points to be featured on the front page! Only true space heroes end up here!

notes.title: Draw & Guess 2.0 is out NOW!
notes.content:
After 2 years in the works and many teasers, we're happy to share a major update for Draw & Guess. This update includes an entire rework of our UI, new features such as match history/sketchbook, and a bunch more! This won't be a sequel, but a [b]FREE[/b] update for everyone!

We're also releasing characters and skins available for a little extra if you wish to support the continued development of Draw & Guess as we expand into new game modes/features.

✨ [b]As a thank you for all the support shown to us over the years, we will add 850 Ink to the accounts of all players who purchased Draw & Guess before the update.[/b]

Here's what awaits you:

[h2]Game Modes[/h2]
We've adjusted the names and looks of game modes but don't worry, the gameplay remains the same!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/873955f45833bed781998500c6845e5e8645e656.png[/img]

[h2]Wordlists[/h2]
Wordlists are now hosted on our own server and you can create, edit, and subscribe to wordlists on the go while inside the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/a017f36accf792c56d075b2a8ec0d26c6f6e2ec9.gif[/img]

[h2]Sketchbook[/h2]
If you want to let your creativity flow on your own with no constraints, the Sketchbook will allow you to work on your masterpieces at any time.

It's now possible to view all drawings from previous matches, download them, or even continue working on them in-game. Long gone are the days you had to quickly screenshot something you wanted to save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/d8bcd704497c1b503e3d5a63586708bf2aefb21d.gif[/img]

[h2]New Tools[/h2]

[h3]Colour Palettes[/h3]
Quick and easy way to have all your favourite colours at hand. Save your palettes and have them always available when playing!

[h3]Layers[/h3]
Can you imagine having 3 layers to plan around your lobby creations? Well, no need to imagine, it's available now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/98b03e1dc41c2626cfdce05f71442d63672eb031.gif[/img]

[h2]Characters[/h2]
You can now choose between 16 characters to stand out among the crowd! They're fully animated and available across all game modes.

We are committed to maintaining the active development of new game modes across Draw & Guess, to make this possible, we are introducing additional characters + skins as part of an [b]optional[/b] monetization system that does not impact gameplay.

We will never block additional features such as game modes, modifiers, or other tools behind a paywall - we believe this solution allows us to continue to offer Draw & Guess at a low price, while also allowing players who wish to support us the opportunity to invest in networking, new unique game modes, and a whole host of new features we're sure you'll love.

Everyone will have Tomoko and Gus available [b]instantly[/b], and you can unlock AL4N, Wanderer, Zoey, and Mei by playing the different game modes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/2c943730596a0991299af3fc4254d32b02a60af6.gif[/img]

[h2]New Language[/h2]
In addition to English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Polish, and Chinese - we now have the game fully available in [b]Portuguese[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/787e1be32add88865bc78db1142800cca09b701f.gif[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
This revamp is just the beginning! We'll be sharing a more detailed roadmap after release, though with this milestone out of the way, we'll be shifting our focus to:
[list]
[*] New game modes (e.g. Battle Royale, Animation, etc)
[*] Mobile release with cross-play PC support
[*] Trust score system for players that frequently abandon/grief games
[*] Dedicated Twitch Integration
[*] ... and more!
[/list]
Lastly, we wanted to thank everyone who supported us while working on Draw & Guess so far. We're extremely happy that you give us the opportunity to continue the development of the game so that we're able to further improve the gameplay experience for our amazing fanbase.

Thank you,
acureus team

notes.title: Draw & Guess Revamp - What’s Next?
notes.content:
[b]🎨 This refers to a completely free update that will download to your game automatically once available in February![/b]

We released the initial version of Draw & Guess back in 2021 as a project made with the help of some friends. Today, thanks to the outpouring of support and creativity of our players, we’ve seen over 3 million players join the Draw & Guess community.

We’re incredibly humbled and thankful for the community that has been building around Draw & Guess - there are two key pieces of recurring feedback we’ve seen from players we want to focus on:
[list]
[*] The game isn’t polished enough
[*] Servers are bad
[/list]
Your voices have been heard and we spent the past two years working through numerous challenges in both these areas, as well as developing some completely new features we believe you’ll love!

Starting mid-February, we’re excited to release a fully revamped version of the game. This won’t be a separate sequel, but a [b]FREE[/b] update for everyone.

[h2]Visual Overhaul[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We have re-designed the user experience from the ground up, as well as developed a new look and feel to the interface of Draw & Guess. Our goal was to design a mix of cozy and casual with stylized 2D art for characters, combined with more realistic art for the interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/1e57833a6cff7b67bd27c3d5c21b09492a4d272d.gif[/img]

[h2]Characters & Ink[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We’re introducing fully animated avatars, usable across all game modes. You may’ve seen our previous announcements with Gus and Scarlet, with more to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39339016/04c39a119cadeb13f90bdb65d718635b94077e02.gif[/img]

These characters will also have skins available as part of our optional monetization system. Our plan moving forward is to invest in high-quality unique game modes, develop our server architecture, as well as to continue to implement meaningful new features - this isn’t possible with the current model.

We do not want to monetize game modes, tools, or any other part of the game that impacts gameplay.

The skin system is our way of implementing a means for players to express themselves and support us if they wish so, allowing us to sustain the development of new features and overall improvements to the game.

✨ [b]As a thank you for all the support shown to us over the years, we will be adding some currency to the accounts of all players who purchased Draw & Guess before the update.[/b] ✨

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The current game modes will keep their core gameplay unchanged, but we've given them a fresh look to address some of the UX problems we saw players experiencing.

More game modes are our #1 priority moving forward. We want to bring you a variety of modes that feel unique and engaging, adding new features to offer a more practical and fun experience to everyone, regardless of how you choose to play, with a strong focus on quality over quantity.

We're adding a whole bunch of completely new features as part of the update. Some of them include:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1483870/announcements/detail/3660918706925499272]Colour Palettes[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/channels/792887682618753074/816349880934989845/1167267937359511562]Sketchbook[/url] (Saved drawings + "Zen drawing" mode)
[*] [url=https://discord.com/channels/792887682618753074/816349880934989845/1177775296523542579]Layers[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1483870/announcements/detail/6714370676636617408]In-game Wordlist browser + revamped editor/publishing[/url]
[/list]
We also have new game modes and features on our roadmap for after the revamp release as we look for ways to keep the gameplay fun and fresh!

[h2]Servers & Networking[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We have spent the past two years collaborating with networking experts developing and experimenting with different approaches/architecture designs to improve the overall experience. If you are a long-time player, you may have already been a part of some of the experiments we've run over the years.

We understand that networking issues can be incredibly frustrating, and as gamers ourselves, we are equally upset when they occur. We want to be transparent with the process.

Steam networking was our choice at release, a P2P-based solution offered by Valve - while this service is free and operates well for most Western players, we saw frequent reports of players in Asia experiencing issues.

For players in China especially, we saw much higher rates of disruption (even when using a VPN) due to lost packets/corrupted data when passing through the firewall. This is an issue for all games with servers located outside of mainland China. Unfortunately, the only solution would be to operate servers locally, however, due to the nature of Draw & Guess being an entirely user-generated content game, local publishers are unable to get the necessary government license for us to use local hosting providers.

We started developing our own networking solution in October 2021, and deployed new solutions over 10 times during the following two years, making significant changes after each update. These tests ran for 1-2 days at a time. In June 2023, after seeing significant improvements consistently compared to Steam's networking solution, we made the switch.

We spent a large portion of our time developing networking infrastructure on "protecting" matches as much as possible from disruption by implementing more recovery measures, hyper-specific to Draw & Guess' use case.

The current solution is not perfect, though we will be continuing to make improvements over time - if you know any games that operate servers outside of China with a high amount of Chinese players, hop in our Discord and let us know!

[h2]Transition Period[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As we gear up for the revamp release, a transition period is underway, including changes to Player Names and Wordlists. Our team is diligently preparing for a smooth release. Stay tuned for updates, and we'll keep communication transparent to help you prepare without any issues.

[h2]Future Roadmap Preview[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The revamp is just the beginning! We'll be sharing a more detailed roadmap after release, though with this milestone out of the way, we'll be shifting our focus to:
[list]
[*] New game modes (e.g. Battle Royale, Animation, etc)
[*] Mobile release with cross-play PC support
[*] Trust score system for players that frequently abandon/grief games
[*] Dedicated Twitch Integration
[*] and more!
[/list]
If there's a feature you'd like to see brought to Draw & Guess, head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/8neSVvanqM]Discord server[/url] and let us know!

[h2]Wrap Up[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We're thrilled to share this two-year effort with you. Your feedback is crucial as we strive to continuously improve Draw & Guess. Share your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.gg/8neSVvanqM]Discord[/url] or here - your voice matters in shaping the future of Draw & Guess.

Hello everyone!

We have rolled out an update to Draw & Guess that will now let you run either the Live or Beta version of the game during startup. 

In preparation of a larger update we have planned, our team has been hard at work completely revamping our multiplayer servers from scratch. 

We have been able to resolve many of the early issues with this system, though are still experiencing a few remaining bugs that can cause lobbies to drop out/players being unable to connect.

- More drawing tools

Once we are confident that our Beta version is more stable than the live version, we will make the full upgrade! 

Thank you all for your support and happy drawing!

notes.title: Update for 02 June - A new game mode supporting 2-16 players!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you for playing Draw&Guess. :-)

Here is the changelog for this update:

[list]
[*] New game mode for 2-16 players: One player draws, everyone else can guess. The faster you guess, the more points you get!
[*] In the next 1-2 days, the game will support Steam Trading Cards - they will drop automatically as you play!
[*] When a game is cancelled due to too many player disconnecting, players are now returned to the lobby and get a notification instead of a sudden disconnect
[*] Timer is now visible even after you have submitted so you can see how much time is remaining
[*] Hosts can now pause the game
[*] There is now a time limit for voting on words and favourite images
[*] Redone Chinese localisation
[*] French default word list now without noun markers
[*] You can now use Ctrl-Z to undo the last stroke
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking on the small selector for brush options caused an undo action
[/list]

Also, we have carefully read your reviews, many of them addressing network issues. The game makes use of Steam Networking, which means the lobby owner is the server. If they disconnect, the game can not recover. As many of you have mentioned, robustness against some connection instability would be nice. This is not easy to implement, but it is one of the top-priority item on our list of features to come!

Please also note that the new game mode will be improved in the coming weeks regarding UI and comfort features. Feedback is very welcome! 

If you mention anything weird with the game, please don't hesitate to send logs to me ( chikari@t-online.de ) - you can reach the log files by clicking "Logs" in the bottom left corner of the main menu (The files are called Player.log and Player-prev.log). This will help us a lot to fix bugs quickly!

Thank you for your patience and keep drawing :-)
